remarks: Prime Location Norwalk 1BR Condo at Prospect Gardens. Ideal starter home or investment at a well-maintained, quiet brick complex. Step inside this light-filled unit featuring a cozy living area with hardwood floors and a spacious eat-in kitchen. Enjoy the ease of having assigned parking, dedicated storage, and common laundry facilities. Common charges include heat, hot water and common area maintenance. Take a short walk to Norwalk Hospital and the vibrant SoNo Collection Mall, trendy downtown dining, and waterfront attractions like the Maritime Aquarium. Excellent commuter access to I-95, Merritt Parkway, and public transportation (bus routes nearby) is a plus. Don't miss this opportunity to own a piece of desirable Norwalk real estate! Whether you're seeking a simple, low-maintenance home or a smart addition to your rental portfolio, this unit is a must-see. Pets allowed. Schedule your showing today!
